prompt: 帮我把 wiki 里关于 LLM 架构演变的研究整理成一个 Marp 幻灯片，放在 outputs/slides/ 下。大概 6-8 页，要有从 Transformer → MoE → 最新的趋势。如果 wiki/concepts/ 里有相关配图也嵌入进去。

assertions.name: creates-marp-file
assertions.text: A Marp slide file is created under outputs/slides/

assertions.name: has-marp-frontmatter
assertions.text: Slide file has marp: true frontmatter

assertions.name: has-sufficient-slides
assertions.text: Has at least 5 slides (reasonable for 6-8 range)

assertions.name: covers-transformer-to-moe
assertions.text: Covers both Transformer and MoE topics
